issues.description: The template PersonResource exposes the GET-all endpoint under the path "persons" (@GetMapping("persons")), whereas the solution's PersonResource uses "people" (@GetMapping("people")). Tests and the rest of the repository (integration tests and REST calls) consistently use "/persons". This discrepancy between template and solution endpoint naming can confuse students about the expected endpoint and the correct URL to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a consistent endpoint path across template, tests, and solution. Change the solution's getAllPersons mapping from @GetMapping("people") to @GetMapping("persons") so it matches the template and the tests (or alternatively update template/tests to use "people" and document the change).

issues.description: The HTTP GET mapping for listing all persons is named inconsistently across artifacts: the template and tests use the path "/persons" while the solution's PersonResource exposes the list endpoint at "/people". This mismatch between the common test/template path and the solution path can confuse students mapping the problem requirement (Person REST API) to the implemented endpoints and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single, consistent path for the list endpoint across template, tests, and solution. Align the solution's @GetMapping to "persons" (or update template/tests to use "people"), preferably "persons" to match existing tests and the rest of the codebase.
